items.title: Your People. Your Playbook.
items.body: We partner with founders and management teams without arriving with a predetermined playbook or trying to reengineer what already works. Your leadership team stays in place, your operating expertise remains at the center, and Black Lake has never eliminated positions as part of an acquisition.

items.title: Shared Success.
items.body: You sell a portion of your business while retaining meaningful ownership, creating the potential for a “second bite of the apple.” Across our last three subsequent transactions, founders received {secondBite} in value from that second transaction, and about {secondTransactionMultiple} more cash on average than in the initial sale.

items.title: Experience Without Ego.
items.body: Black Lake has completed {transactions} transactions across seven platforms, generating {cashOnCash} cash-on-cash realized returns on equity invested. We ask hard questions, stay flexible when circumstances change, and bring perspective without pretending we have every answer.

items.title: The Deal Should Fit the Business.
items.body: Your company should not have to fit someone else’s investment formula. We evaluate opportunities deal by deal and structure the investment around the opportunity instead of forcing it into a predetermined box.
